programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Atlanta Braves' third baseman Austin Riley is usually spending his September and October holding it down on the hot corner in the MLB playoffs. programme.desc: Mark Peterson is in the final stretch of completing the South America Upland Slam. programme.title: The Journey Within

programme.title: S1E1 Two Roads
programme.desc:
“Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today.
This episode features Olympic bronze medalist Kristian Ipsen, American rugby union star Carlin Isles — celebrated as “The Fastest Man in Rugby” — and his remarkable rise from track and field and American football to becoming a two-time Olympian in rugby sevens. You’ll also meet Allison Stokke, a record-breaking high school pole vaulter who went on to compete at UC Berkeley, and Miles Chamley-Watson, a British-American fencing champion whose career includes 13 team Pan American titles, a 2019 team world championship, a 2013 individual world championship, three Olympic appearances, and a 2016 team Olympic bronze medal.

programme.title: Soul Men
programme.desc: Louis (Samuel L. Jackson) and Floyd (Bernie Mac) used to be one of the country's top musical duos, until they broke up and never spoke again. Old animosities resurface 20 years later when the two are thrust together on a cross-country trip to take part in a tribute concert honoring their late band leader. Louis and Floyd have just five short days to bury the hatchet -- hopefully not in someone's head -- before they take the stage at New York's Apollo Theater.

programme.title: Sprung
programme.desc: Clyde (Joe Torry) and his photographer pal Montel (Rusty Cundieff) meet gold digger Adina (Paula Jai Parker) and her friend Brandy (Tisha Campbell), a law student, at a party. While Clyde convinces Adina that he's wealthy, Montel and Brandy pair off and get along well. Adina is furious when she learns Clyde has misled her, but when they learn their friends plan to marry -- which would force the two enemies to spend time together -- they put their differences aside to thwart the marriage.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: Chaos
programme.desc: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

programme.title: The Inspection
programme.desc: A young, gay Black man with few options for his future decides to join the Marines, willing to do whatever it takes to prove himself to his estranged mother and triumph in a system that would otherwise cast him aside. However, even as he battles deep-seated prejudice and the grueling rigor of basic training, he finds unexpected camaraderie, strength and support in this new community, giving him a hard-won sense of belonging that shapes his identity and forever changes his life.

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: A policeman (Mario Van Peebles) learns that the CIA saved a deranged killer from execution to use as a government assassin.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Who Was Geli Bendl?
programme.desc: Only the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) knows the identity of an actress (Sydne Rome) returned home to Sparta, Miss.

programme.title: The Message
programme.desc: Detective Andrea Oya and FBI agent Samantha Curry team up and hunt down a serial killer to solve a string of murders targeting Black women and Black children.

programme.title: Blood Brother
programme.desc: A recently released convict takes murderous revenge against his childhood friends who let him take the fall for their crimes.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Give Me Your Life
programme.desc: As Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Harriet prepare to leave for their honeymoon, Forbes (Carl Weathers) clashes with a charismatic cult leader (Peter Fonda) who has arrived in Sparta.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Who Was Geli Bendl?
programme.desc: Only the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) knows the identity of an actress (Sydne Rome) returned home to Sparta, Miss.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: By Duty Bound
programme.desc: A murder suspect (Corbin Bernsen) works for a businessman running against Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) for sheriff.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Grow Old Along With Me
programme.desc: Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Forbes (Carl Weathers) link a suspect to a witness of a hit-and-run fatality.

programme.title: In the Mix
programme.desc: Mobster Frank (Chazz Palminteri) hires hip DJ Darrell (Usher) to man the turntables at a party for his gorgeous daughter, Dolly (Emmanuelle Chriqui). At the event, some crooks pull guns on the gangster, and Darrell steps in to save his life. Frank then gives the DJ a job as his daughter's bodyguard, but, to the mobster's dismay, Dolly starts to fall for the smooth-talking Darrell. Their romance is interrupted when Frank gets involved in a mob war and drags Darrell along with him.

programme.title: The Last Letter
programme.desc: Catherine Wright struggles with a debilitating sleep disorder. Her husband Michael struggles to cope when their newborn son lies awake.

programme.title: Chaos
programme.desc: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

programme.title: Caballos de acero
programme.desc: Un joven rico es aficionado al motociclismo y conoce a un teniente de la policía con quien rivaliza en aptitudes.

programme.title: Noche de muerte
programme.desc: Un delincuente se disfraza como un famoso luchador y asalta varios lugares matando a los guardias de seguridad.

programme.title: La cárcel de Laredo
programme.desc: Un hombre poderoso separa a su hija del novio, un mecánico, y lo envía a la prisión, a pesar de que la joven está embarazada.

programme.title: La venganza de un matón
programme.desc: María, una bailarina de salón, conoce a Ted y se enamoran. Ella queda embarazada, pero Ted sufre un accidente donde pierde la memoria y queda muy herido. Cuatro años después de su recuperación, va en busca de María.

programme.title: Los fugitivos
programme.desc: Cuatro jóvenes narcotraficantes huyen de la policía y se esconden en un rancho donde hay tres mujeres.

programme.title: Con la Muerte en Ancas
programme.desc: Dos pistoleros, con personalidades distintas, uno, un hombre justo, y el otro, un asesino psicópata, buscan la venganza.

programme.title: Los caifanes
programme.desc: Cinco hombres y una mujer deciden encontrar nuevas formas de diversión sin pensar en el efecto que tendrá en su vida.

programme.title: Sábado Violento
programme.desc: Dos hermanos periodistas compiten entre sí por obtener los mejores reportajes, hasta el punto de arriesgar la vida.

programme.title: La Ley de las Calles
programme.desc: Después de cuatro años un hombre es liberado de la cárcel y al salir es atacado por los hermanos de su novia.

programme.title: Remolino
programme.desc: La historia de una mujer que juega con los sentimientos de dos hombres, haciéndolos caer en un torbellino de pasión.

programme.title: Las aventuras de Juliancito
programme.desc: Juliancito y su amigo están hartos del trato de sus papás, por lo que deciden irse a vivir a una isla y hacer creer a sus familias que están muertos para darles una lección.

programme.title: Vámonos para la feria
programme.desc: Un hombre decide que es hora de que sus dos hijos se casen. Para eso, acude a su compadre, que tiene dos bellas hijas.

programme.title: Romance en Puerto Rico
programme.desc: Una joven escapa como polizón en un barco que viaja a Puerto Rico para no casarse con un millonario.

programme.title: Dos valientes
programme.desc: Martín, un pistolero, es asesinado, pero antes de morir pide que le oculten su identidad a su hijo. Este corre peligro cuando asiste a su funeral.

programme.title: Hoy He Soñado con Dios
programme.desc: Una mujer tiene tres hijos muy diferentes: una hija fracasada, el otro un boxeador furtivo y su hijo el sacerdote.

programme.title: Pepenadores de acá
programme.desc: A pesar de ser inocente, un vendedor ambulante cree que lo buscan por asesinato, así que se esconde entre los recolectores en el basurero de la ciudad.

programme.title: El hijo del palenque
programme.desc: Un gallero es asesinado en su palenque, y su esposa muere al dar a luz. Un amigo de ellos lleva al niño con su abuela.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants are seated at a table behind six covered trays that conceal six different types of Fear Factor Sausages. For this "Best Friends" final stunt, both team members will be seated in separate stunt cars on opposite ends of a track, indirectly facing each other. On "go", both contestants must drive their car at towards their own pipe ramp.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: This was an extended 4-stunt episode. For the first stunt, contestants have to hang by their ankles from trapeze hanging from a helicopter that flew over 20 flagpoles. The have to release as many flags as possible. In the second stunt, they are strapped down and their left arm would be pierced by 10 needles which would get progressively thicker.
programme.sub-title: Helicopter Slalom, Piercings, Maggoty Cheese, Flag Snag

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Male contestants must identify disgusting items, then eat any they guess incorrectly; female contestants must retrieve dead feeder mice with their mouths while swimming in a vat of dead rodents.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: For the first stunt, contestants ride a raft behind a speedboat. They climb a rope hanging from a helicopter and release 6 flags before dropping 20 feet into the water. If contestants completed this stunt, they would win $1,000.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: In this couples stunt, the contestants will be standing on opposite platforms suspended 100 feet in the air. Contestants will have to siphon gross fluid (worms, crickets, cow parts, pig parts etc) out of 4 containers and into a large funnel.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants must drop out of a helicopter and race to pick up flags while swimming, and participate in a gross pot luck dinner. Then they must make their way through an airborne greasy maze.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants get dragged by a horse, rest in a pit of rats and crawl on a car suspended 150 feet in the air.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants must stand on a truck as it drives through a tunnel, hit targets to avoid eating bugs, and dodge eing flipped by a tractor.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Perched on the hood of a car suspended 100 feet high by a giant electric magnet, contestants must switch it off, sending themselves and the vehicle plummeting toward a target on the ground.
programme.sub-title: Triple Beam Walk/Glass Walking/Magnetic Car Drop

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will be laying on their back bound at their ankles, waist, and one wrist to a plexiglass platform that is hung from a helicopter. Contestants will play a game to determine how much skunk, possum, rattlesnake and armadillo they will have to eat. Contestants will have to cross 4, 20-foot rotating beams placing flags along the way.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Players must wedge themselves between two walls to avoid falling, eat live snails, and jump cars into trucks.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Are you worth a Dam? Suspended high over a dam is a 350-foot long tightrope with flags attached. Contestants would have to cross the tightrope and collect flags while holding on to a higher tightrope for support. The two men and the two women to collect the most flags in 5 minutes would advance to the next round. Stunt 2 is a real Bee. The ones left are covered with over 200,000 honeybees.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: It's hot for the first stunt as contestants climb a ladder, enter the fourth floor, follow a hose line to a room they put out a fire, rescue a dummy, and get out of the building. The two slowest are eliminated. In the second stunt, they lie in pit with over 3,000 scorpions.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Couples Episode - Contestants brave a gross dunk tank and slalom to grab flags from a speeding helicopter

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants climb a rope ladder hanging from a spinning girder and cross monkey bars from one end of the girder to the other and release a flag and drop into the water below. It's Breakfast of Champions as they have to eat balut eggs silkworm moth cocoons in brine, and liquefied pig liver.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants must hold their breath in a leech-filled coffin and drive a motorcycle off a 100-foot cliff in hopes of winning $1 million.

programme.title: Fear Factor 2.0 USA
programme.desc: Four sets of twins compete for $50,000 as they are electric shocked

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: In this episode we see stunts including the Free Fall, Sheep delicacies and upside down water tank.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants must race to milk a goat with their mouths, and unlock themselves from a box which let's them fall from a helicopter.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: The contestants will be riding on the back of a jet ski, traveling at approx. 25 to 30 miles per hour. Contestants are placed in a plexiglass helmet, which is then filled with water and moray eels. The contestants must ride a platform that is continuously moving up or down, along the way there are 6 stations that they must get off and retrieve a flag and return to the moving platform.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Couples Episode - Players will lean over a ledge to collect flags, bob in rats, and cut cables off their hog-tied partner.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will be lying on their backs in a muddy trough on the roof of a building. On "go" the contestants will be dragged through the mud and must pluck as many flags as they can before dropping off the edge of the building.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's being weighed down underwater, digging into rotten picnic snacks, and a tag-team challenge on a moving train.
programme.sub-title: Blind Date Fear Factor: Take Two

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants must hang on as they are dragged through water, juice cow eyes with their mouths, and jump between moving trucks to gather flags.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: 2 poles will be attached and hung off the front end of a dump truck, contestants must make their way out on the pole pulling flags as they make their way to the end. Contestants will be standing on a car that is suspended over the water by a crane. The car is specially designed to rotate like a rotisserie.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: In this episode we see stunts including the Leap on Faith, Pig Eat and High speed Climbing wall.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will be seated in the driver's seat and truck of a stretch limousine suspended on a 45-degree angle just above the surface of the water. Contestants will have to transfer a gross blend of bugs through a plexiglass tube. Contestants are tied into their seat and to the steering wheel of a convertible automobile, which will be hanging over a cliff approx 100-feet in the air.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Family Episode - Players will walk on high beams, be buried in roaches, and catapult their children into a lake.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants go through the Fear Factor Triathalon. Contestants must guide their blindfolded partner through a maze of electrical tripwires designed to deliver a safe but shocking electrical charge when triggered. For every sprung tripwire, both contestants will receive a jolt.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Boat Jump As two ultra boats raced down a lake at 40 miles per hour, contestants would have to jump the gap between them that was approximately 7 feet wide and land on the second boat. Contestants who jumped from boat to boat successfully would advance to the next round.

programme.desc: When Tess's ideal fantasy world collides with reality, she finds herself being forced to decide between Nick and Dave, the two men who love her.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Tess's birthday forces her to take a long, hard look at herself, but she "sees" more than she bargained for and unwittingly creates some midsummer night's madness. Sandra and Harry ask Nick to father a child for them.

programme.title: Third Day
programme.desc: On the third day after Jesus' crucifixion, eyewitnesses reported that they found an empty tomb and had an encounter with a living, breathing Jesus of Nazareth. What proof do we have that the resurrection really happened? This intriguing documentary digs deep into the biblical and historical accounts and explores these questions: Did the disciples steal the body?

programme.title: Mystery of the Shroud
programme.desc: In a tomb located in Jerusalem's Hell Valley, on land bought with Judas Iscariot's bloodstained silver, a sensational discovery was made. Vital information has been uncovered to paint a picture of what Jesus' grave would have looked like and what his burial process involved. One of the key moments in Christian history is made real and contemporary through this exciting archaeological discovery.

programme.title: Herod's Temple: The Temple Jesus Knew
programme.desc: Jerusalem, rich in historical and Biblical heritage, is the home of the Temple Mount, one of the world's most recognizable and visited sacred sites. Now, travel back in time to see it the way Jesus and his disciples did over 2,000 years ago. They knew it as Herod's Temple. We remember it as the Temple Jesus knew.

programme.title: The Week That Changed The World
programme.desc: The resurrection happened. It's not just the belief of Christians, it's borne out by history, archaeology, and science. This documentary takes viewers step by step through the events of Holy Week-shedding light on the key players, unraveling the political intrigue, and answering long standing questions about what happened, and why. Professor of ancient history and world-renowned expert Dr. Paul L.

programme.title: Jeremy's Egg
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Jeremy is terminally ill and the only special-needs child in second grade. One day his teacher gives her students plastic eggs with the instructions to fill them with something that symbolizes Easter and new life.

programme.title: Jesus and the Early Church
programme.desc: James and Jude were the brothers of Jesus, who like Jesus, grew up in their father's carpenters shop in Nazareth. It was only after Jesus' death and resurrection that they became his followers, with James heading up the Jerusalem Church. Each of them wrote letters to the believers with James encouraging them to do good deeds as well as believe.

programme.title: My Son My Savior
programme.desc: From the makers of the award winning biblical dramas, Road to Emmaus and Come Follow Me, comes My Son, My Savior, a powerful portrayal of the life of Jesus as seen through the eyes of his mother, Mary.

programme.title: Ancient Secrets of the Bible
programme.desc: An investigation into the identity of Mary Magdalene, one the Bible's best known women, produces startling insights. Who was she? A fallen woman rescued by Jesus or Christ's beloved disciple?
programme.sub-title: Biblical Women: Was Mary Magdalene a Saint or Sinner?

programme.title: Tomb of Jesus: The Evidence
programme.desc: The Real Discoveries team visit two tombs each believed to be the tombs where Jesus was laid to rest and later rose. However, Jesus could not have been laid and risen from both tombs. Is there any evidence to support the fact that either of these sites is the genuine one? Find out as we journey to discover the Tomb of Jesus!

programme.title: Twelve Ordinary Men
programme.desc: A look at the twelve disciples who were hand-picked by Jesus to learn from his teachings, and spread the gospel after his crucifixion. Why these men?

programme.title: Jeremiah
programme.desc: Jeremiah tells the story of the prophet who abandons his family and the woman he loves in order to relay God's message in Jerusalem. Although he is persecuted and branded as a traitor for warning others of the destruction of the Holy City, he continues fearlessly with his mission. When his prophecy is fulfilled, he experiences first-hand Jerusalem's destruction by the Babylonians.

programme.title: Heavens to Betsy 2
programme.desc: Author Betsy Simon (Karen Lesiewicz) finally finds career success when her new novel, Heavens to Betsy, is published. Following advice from her agent (Ruth Kaufman), she tells the public that the book is a work of fiction. After talking with Pastor John (Jim O'Heir from TV's 'Parks and Recreation') she claims that the events portrayed in the book actually happened to her!

programme.title: Christmas Wedding Runaway
programme.desc: A runaway bride does some soul-searching when she's trapped in a snowed-in cabin with her grandmother and an old flame at Christmas.

programme.title: Solomon
programme.desc: Solomon is crowned King of Israel and rules the land with love, peace and respect. While visiting the city, Solomon meets the beautiful Queen of Sheba and falls in love. When she returns to her homeland, Solomon falls into a deep depression, departing from his once idyllic world of peace and luxury while his kingdom threatens to collapse.

programme.title: Grace and Gravity
programme.desc: John Palmer, an American Christian visiting the UK comes across a suicidal British atheist who is about to throw himself off a bridge. Will John convince the man to turn to Christ and live or will John be overcome by his own weaknesses and doubts? Staring Bruce Marchiano (The Encounter) and Richard Brimblecombe (For Love's Sake).

programme.title: Life Fine Tuned
programme.desc: A spoiled young pop star learns a lesson in humility after being cut from her big show and replaced with a stand-in. Now lost in rural Virginia she must learn how to get in tune with those around her. This family friendly comedy-drama is ideal for tweens and young teens. It addresses issues of identity, humility, family and salvation.

programme.title: We Were There
programme.desc: We Were There captures the voices of America's greatest generation, as they share their stories of duty, service, and responsibility during World War II. While the tumultuous global events of the early 1940's provide the backdrop for this film, it is the men and women recalling their personal stories who take center stage.

programme.title: A Christmas Village
programme.desc: To save her reputation, Piper Jensen, a public relations genius and owner of her own PR company, agrees to work for the owner of a failing Santa's Village and discovers love and how magical Christmas is after all.

programme.title: Romero Collector's Edition
programme.desc: In honor of Archbishop Oscar Romero of El Salvador, the Romero Collector's Edition film has been remastered and chronicles the amazing true transformation of an apolitical, complacent priest to a committed leader, who started a revolution without guns, without an army, without fear.

programme.title: Jesus
programme.desc: This production aims to stimulate interest on the part of a Biblically illiterate generation to want to know more about the Gospels and the extraordinary life, death, resurrection and meaning of Jesus.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens

programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: This week we are celebrating the work of the army of volunteers, which keeps gardens up and down the country looking their best for visitors. programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is preparing for spring colour as well as harvesting pumpkins and squashes. programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty's thoughts turn to spring when he gives recommendations for bulbs to plant that will thrive in pots. He also shows how to prune summer fruiting raspberries. In Norfolk, Frances Tophill visits a gardener who at 97 still gardens every day.

programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With one of the driest summers in many years, Monty responds to viewers' questions and has plenty of advice on how to deal with drought conditions for vegetables, fruit, flowers and containers. Carol Klein celebrates one of the most flamboyant summer shrubs, the hydrangea.

programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.desc: The team celebrate the bounty our gardens have to offer at this time of year as Carol Klein gathers wild blackberries, Monty Don is at Longmeadow, and we join a champion vegetable grower in Yorkshire as he prepares for the biggest show of the season.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Desert Lands of the Middle East
programme.desc: 96% of Egypt's lands are sun-blistered desert. Rock and sand dominate this country, creating a beautiful but hostile environment. Yet it was home to the Worlds greatest ancient civilisation, which flourished for millennia and still captivates us today. These harsh lands also hold amazing animals that can survive and even thrive, able to cope with and profit from the searing temperatures and lack of moisture.

programme.title: Destination Wild - India's Lost Worlds
programme.desc: The Western Ghats are amongst some of the most biodiverse regions in the world, and these mountains are the ancestral birthplace for many of India's endemic species. This episode delves into India's jungle heart, and the mysterious forests nestled in the shadow of the Western Ghats' great peaks. Amongst these trees lies the fabled world from the pages of history, and the character counterparts to the West's most cherished tales of India - Rudyard Kipling's 'The Jungle Book'.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: This episode follows the animals of Argentina, living life at the mercy of the Andean mountains. These peaks dictate a hard existence for every living creature from their summits to the very edge of the Patagonian steppe, forcing even the cutest resident to turn carnivore... Predators stalk the foothills and creepy crawlies lie low in the sandy steppe. Every animal here has a bloodthirsty drive to survive.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Stretching almost 1000 miles, from the jungles of Brazil to the southernmost point of South America, Patagonia's coast is home to some of the natural world's most spectacular animals. Here, a parched desert collides with a powerful ocean, but right along this extreme and hostile coastline, animals battle the elements and each other, in a fight for survival.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Argentina's northern territory contains one of the largest reserves in the country. Iberá is a vast expanse of swamps, marshes and lagoons, with a biodiversity count to rival the Pantanal. These lands are bursting with life, home to over 4000 animal and plant species. The rainy season in Iberá finds the wetlands in bloom... but unseen perils lurk beneath the surface, and even here, life can be a struggle for survival.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: Spanning the western length of Colombia, the Chocó region is thought to be one of most biodiverse places on the planet. When the Andes Mountains rose around 60 million years ago they isolated this wild coast creating a haven for evolution. It is the wettest place on earth, on average 13m of water falls every year. Combined with the varied topography of the Western Andes and the year round tropical heat, it is the perfect environment for species to adapt and evolve.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: In the middle of Colombia, lies an ancient, unique and little explored outcrop of sandstone; the Serrania de la Macarena. It forms part of the country's first ever national park - made up of lush jungle, shrubland and savannah, isolated peaks, winding rivers and spectacular waterfalls - where more than 15 million specimens were collected during early studies of the area. Called the 'treasure of the world', scientists believe it is a hugely important bank of biological diversity.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: Chiribiquete is an unknown world, hidden deep within Colombia's Amazon. Pre-historic towers, waterfalls and deep canyons lie surrounded by rivers, lakes and rainforests bursting with life. Scientists have only guessed at what else lies beneath this impenetrable pristine jungle - until now. Biologist Blanca Huertas from England's Natural History Museum, and Colombian-born nature photographer Francisco Forero, head deep into the heart of nowhere.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: Over the last million years, our planet suffered a series of major ice-ages. Much of the northern hemisphere was covered in ice sheets several kilometres thick and creatures had no choice but to adapt or die. Over time, temperatures rose, causing these glaciers to retreat, however, in certain parts of Europe the ice-age never left. For many creatures, the struggle to survive 'a life below zero' continues.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: Europe was once covered by forest, from the Arctic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea. Wiped out in a mini ice age around 15000 years ago, they, and the wildlife that inhabit them are making a spectacular recovery. Today, Europe's forests cover around 1 000 million hectares (about 30 times the size of Poland).

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: The story of Europe's living waters begins at great altitude. Melt waters from the highest snow-capped peaks feed some of the greatest rivers. On their relentless downward journey, streams and rivers have carved through all of Europe's greatest landscapes. Gorges, lakes and wetlands are home to an incredible array of wildlife and seas and oceans have sculpted a coastline of endless variety.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Caribbean has been shaped by millions of years of unstoppable volcanic forces and ferocious hurricanes, creating a network of 7,000 islands, each one more unique than the next. From islets only a few miles long to landmasses with towering peaks, the habitats of this tropical paradise range from lush rainforests hiding untold species to multi-coloured coral reefs teeming with marine life.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: Nestled alongside Canada's south west coast, Vancouver Island is home to the richest Pacific wildlife. Sea lions and killer whales are among the marine predators enjoying the abundant seafood in the surrounding waters, while black bears, marmots and beavers enjoy the rich pickings on land. But each fall, the islands inhabitants must adapt and prepare to face the coming winter. Some will leave, among them humpback whales and turkey vultures who migrate to warmer climes.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Falkland Islands' pristine coastlines and bountiful seas offer a lifeline and breeding centre for millions of penguins each year. Though while some find sanctuary on dry land, there's a daily battle to survive in the waters which surround these wild and rocky shores.

programme.title: Destination Wild: Wild Madagascar
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, hundreds of castaway creatures crash-landed on Madagascar's rugged shores. Isolated from the mainland, evolution went into overdrive. Of almost a quarter of a million species found on the island are unique. This myriad of bizarre life forms had a huge impact on the early human settlers - one particular group of primates shaped their culture, fuelling folklore and legend that still guides their lives today. programme.title: Destination Wild - Desert Lands of the Middle East
programme.desc: Turkey sits on a jumbled collection of tectonic plates, whose collisions have created a tortuous landscape. In fact 80% of Turkeys terrain is rough, broken and mountainous. Mountain ranges both collect and block weather systems, affecting the climate across the country and producing huge contrasts between and within differing habitats.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS visits the location of the "shot heard round the world" at the Colonial Inn in Concord, Massachusetts. Some of the reported activity includes shadowy figures, people being touched, objects flying off the shelf, and power surges. The history goes all the way back to 1775, when wounded soldiers from the Battle of Concord were brought to the site for medical attention.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team is on Rose Island to investigate their haunted lighthouse. This island housed cholera victims exiled from Newport, and many of the sick never returned to the mainland. From inside the quarantine room of the barracks, people have heard voices or felt uneasy.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team is invited to Lemp Mansion in St. Louis, Missouri. There have been tragic deaths at this mansion with the patriarch and three of his children taking their own lives. There are reported feelings of uneasiness in 'the office,' which is where William Lemp committed suicide. The bar area was once the bedroom of Charles Lemp, who killed his dog and then himself it's said that people see him walking around with his dog at his side.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is asked to investigate the abandoned Milton School in Alton, Ill. where some students are said to still be walking through the halls. In the 1930's a young student named Mary was killed at the school, and the janitor who was the prime suspect then committed suicide inside the building. There are claims that people feel a child holding their hand and smell bubble gum.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Ohio and to the Thurber house, the home of author James Thurber, who wrote The Night the Ghost Got In based off his paranormal experiences there. The house's history is checkered; for starters, it was built on top of where an insane asylum once stood. Seven women died - a man killed his wife and then himself. Lights turn themselves on and off, people have seen apparitions and heard footsteps, and a clock spontaneously comes to life.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters TAPS returns to Mansfield, Ohio to investigate the Bissman Building, where the current manager, Ellis Byrd, was nearly choked to death by a black mist. The Bissman Building has been in his family for five generations, and has its fair share of paranormal activity. Many believe the activity started in 1911 following a violent death where an employee was decapitated by the building's elevator.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS starts out at the Ulster County Jail in Kingston, NY, where inmates and personal have both witnessed activity. The claims there range from objects moving on their own to ghosts talking to people. A ghost with hollowed out eyes and long white hair confronted a guard, and another guard was poked in the head by one of the spirits.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Beardslee Castle in Little Falls, NY, which is a home turned into a restaurant/ bar that has lots of interesting claims. Some of these claims include screams, voices, doors opening, singing, and a lady who forms standing next to a window. Steve and Grant get started on the door that opens on its own in the kitchen. Steve starts to open a nearby door and sure enough, the other door opens forcefully as well. Debunked!
programme.sub-title: Home is Where the Haunt Is

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Fort William Henry located in Lake George, New York, where Ghost Hunters Academy winner Adam Berry joins the team. Before the team heads out, we learn that Kris and Britt will be joining the GHI team and heading to Eastern Europe. The fort was built in 1755. During the French and Indian War, local Native American tribes defeated the British, killing over 1,000 people.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads south to Atlanta, Georgia to investigate Rhodes Hall, where they will be joined by the stars of the Real Housewives of Atlanta, NeNe Leakes, Sheree Whitfield, and Kim Zolciak. Traci Clark, the Hall's communications director, tells the team about the history and the activity that has been reported. Amos Rhodes built the home in 1904, and his family resided there for 20 years, before Amos passed away in the home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS gets into the Christmas spirit at New Hampshire's Christmas Farm Inn. Gary Plourde, the owner, gives the guys the tour and shares some of the reported activity. The stories range from apparitions and footsteps, to the sounds of children playing and the feeling of being watched. Jason and Grant start out the night in the Carriage House spa and start to hear some footsteps around them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates the entire town of Alexandria, Louisiana, where paranormal activity seems to lurk around every corner. The first stop on their paranormal tour is the Hotel Bentley, where among other reports, disembodied conversations are heard, and a little girl trips people on the stairs. The next stop is Finnegan's Wake Tavern, where there are reports of shadows moving, loud bangs coming from upstairs, and a glass breaking on its own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Chester County, Pennsylvania to investigate the Pennhurst Asylum. Pennhurst was forcibly shut down in 1986 for mistreatment of patients, overcrowding and abuse. Some of the claims are screams being heard, people being pushed, doors opening and closing on their own, shadows, and apparitions.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Oxford, Massachusetts to help a family in need. The house has been in the Voas family for two generations, and lots of activity has been reported, from apparitions and shadow figures to footsteps and conversations. A braid of hair and shoe were also found in the basement during renovations.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to America's most haunted city, New Orleans, to investigate the Old U.S. Mint. This mint-turned-museum has lots of reported activity, including shadow figures, thuds, noises, female apparitions, lights flickering and alarms going off. Steve and Tango start off their night on the second floor. While the guys are walking around a door suddenly opens and then slams shut all on its own, leaving the guys speechless.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode on Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to South Dakota for the first time to investigate the Alex Johnson Hotel, a place filled with history. Some of the paranormal activity reported are apparitions, voices, objects being moved, growling sounds, and a story of a bride to be either being killed or committing suicide. The TAPS team also welcomes Maddie, the ghost-hunting dog.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Prospect, Maine to investigate Fort Knox, built before the Civil War to protect the Penobscot narrows. Some of the reported activity has been sounds of stones skipping, doors opening, apparitions, and a strong feeling of evil being felt. Britt is back with the TAPS team and the guys get set up. Jason and Grant start in Long Alley, and the guys see something strange appear on the thermal camera.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Worcester, Massachusetts to investigate the Higgins Armory, the only armory in the western hemisphere devoted to arms and armor. Some of the activity that has been reported is loud knocking, banging, footsteps, music, doors opening/closing, and the apparition of the former owner. Jason and Grant get started in the Quest Gallery, and they see a chain moving on its own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Derby, Connecticut to investigate one of the country's oldest Opera houses, the Sterling Opera House. Some of the reported paranormal activity is a woman in white, as well as a gentleman in a period suit, and shadows. Some believe the Opera House's builder Charles Sterling haunts it, because he died two years before the building was complete.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels for the first time to Hawaii to investigate the Pacific Aviation Museum at Pearl Harbor in Honolulu. Steve can't fly, so he isn't able to make the trip, but Britt is helping out, as well as Destination Truth's Josh Gates. Some of the activity that has been reported is whispers, cold air being felt, apparitions, and cameras being turned on and off on command.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Last time on Ghost Hunters, the team was in Hawaii investigating the Pacific Aviation Museum with special guest Josh Gates, when Steve called Jason with an urgent personal case back in Rhode Island that involves a terrified 4 year old. Jason and Grant hop the first flight back, and meet up with Steve at TAPS headquarters to get the low down on this next case. While there they conference in to do the reveal back in Hawaii with Tango and Amy.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team travels to New Castle, Pennsylvania to investigate Hill View Manor. Before closing in 2004, this old nursing facility had many reports of death by suicide. Some of the paranormal claims by staff members includes unexplained reflections, voices, full body apparitions, shadow figures, the sounds of machines, and people seeing a little boy known as Jeffrey. After seeing Jeffrey, the patients would soon pass away.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal group to investigate Seaview Terrace in Newport, RI. Built in 1923 by the Bradley family, Seaview Terrace is recognizable from TV's "Dark Shadows" which filmed there in the 1960's. Some of the reported activity includes an apparition of Mrs. Bradley, voices, feelings of being watched, seeing faces, and the temperature fluctuating. Jason and Grant start out in the Great Hall and try to get Mrs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Townsend, Massachusetts to investigate the Townsend Historical Society's two houses; the Reed Homestead and the Spaulding Cooperage. The main goal is to help staff not be afraid of paranormal activity that seems to be taking place at both properties. Built in 1809, the Reed Homestead was home to four generations of the Oliver Reed family. One of Oliver Reed's four daughters, Hannah, hanged herself after the death of her young daughter.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to the Carnegie Library Homestead, in Homestead, Pennsylvania. This Library was the site of violent riots between Carnegie and the steel workers. It is said that Carnegie built the library to win the steel workers over. It is thought that steel workers or Carnegie himself could be haunting the building. Some of the reported activity includes shadow figures, books falling off shelves, apparitions, and voices.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Hawaii's Plantation Village, which was once a sugar plantation. It it is now an outdoor museum with reports of spirits still wandering the property and the many authentically replicated homes. It is believed that some of the entities seen are those who committed suicide or were murdered.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS and Jason's daughter, Haily, head to Napanoch, New York to investigate the Shanley Hotel. Since its opening in 1845, The Shanley Hotel has been plagued by an abundance of inexplicable deaths and tragic events targeting children. One of these tragic stories involved a little girl named Rosie, who died as she fell down a well while playing with friends. Some of the reports are of apparitions and toys moving in various rooms of the hotel.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal team to ever investigate the historic Friars Club in New York City. Built in 1904 and famous for its roasts, TAPS has been brought in to find out if comedian, Al Kelly, is behind all the activity. There have been reports that an old man can be heard grunting, cold air surrounding someone, lockers moving, shadows, and apparitions of a man sitting at a table.

programme.desc: Zack (Dane Cook) and Vince (Dax Shepard) are rival co-workers at Super Club, the country's largest bulk-discount retailer, but while Vince is on the fast track at Super Club, Zack's laid-back approach to work holds him back. That all changes when a new cashier, named Amy (Jessica Simpson), transfers to their store. Zack is instantly smitten, but Amy prefers Vince. Zack determines that the only way to win her is to win his store's most coveted honor.

programme.title: Drowning Mona
programme.desc: The recently deceased Mona Dearly was many things: an abusive wife, a domineering mother, a loud-mouthed neighbor and a violent malcontent. So when her car and corpse are discovered in the Hudson River, police Chief Wyatt Rash immediately suspects murder rather than an accident. But, since the whole community of Verplanck, N.Y., shares a deep hatred for this unceasingly spiteful woman, Rash finds his murder investigation overwhelmed with potential suspects.

programme.title: Throw Momma From the Train
programme.desc: Larry (Billy Crystal), an author with a cruel ex-wife, Margaret (Kate Mulgrew), teaches a writing workshop where Owen (Danny DeVito), one of his students, is fed up with his domineering mother (Anne Ramsey). When Owen watches a Hitchcock classic that seems to mirror his own life, he decides to put the movie's plot into action and offers to kill Margaret, if Larry promises to murder his mom. Before Larry gets a chance to react to the plan, it seems that Owen has already sealed Margaret's fate.

programme.title: Larger Than Life
programme.desc: Jack Corcoran (Bill Murray) is a struggling motivational speaker who lives by the mantra Get over it! When he learns his circus clown father has died and left him Vera, an 8,000-pound elephant, as an inheritance, he considers only one option: selling his father's beloved pet. He finds two buyers -- but must then get Vera to California, thousands of miles away, in just five days. With the help of an eccentric truck driver (Matthew McConaughey), Jack and Vera set out on one crazy road trip.

programme.title: The Honor List
programme.desc: Four girls sink a time capsule in a lake with a list of things they want to do before graduation, but they all go separate ways before graduating. When a tragedy strikes, they reunite to find the capsule and complete the bucket list.

programme.title: The Longshots
programme.desc: Curtis Plummer (Ice Cube), a down-on-his-luck former football player, becomes the new coach of the Minden, Illinois, Pop Warner football team. With his niece Jasmine (Keke Palmer) installed as the team's quarterback and secret weapon, Curtis has a chance to turn his life around, while the residents of Minden have a chance to recapture their team spirit and civic pride.

programme.title: I Hate Kids
programme.desc: Nick Pearson is a life-long bachelor who is finally settling down. On the brink of his wedding, he is surprised to find he has a 13-year-old son who located him through the help of a psychic. Nick can't stand kids and would happily send the boy back to live with his biological mother, but nobody knows who the woman might be. Having nowhere to turn, Nick must hit the road with the boy and the neurotic psychic to locate dozens of his ex-flings and ask one very awkward question to all of them.

programme.title: Criminal
programme.desc: CIA agent Bill Pope (Ryan Reynolds) dies while traveling to a secret location to meet a hacker who can launch missiles at will. Desperate to find his whereabouts, officials turn to an experimental neurosurgeon who can transfer memories from one brain to another. The guinea pig for the procedure is Jerico Stewart (Kevin Costner), a violent and dangerous death-row inmate. Now gifted with Pope's skills and knowledge, Stewart must race against time to stop a sinister international conspiracy.

programme.title: Destroyer
programme.desc: As a young cop, Erin Bell went undercover to infiltrate a gang in the California desert -- with tragic results. Bell continues to work as a detective for the Los Angeles Police Department, but feelings of anger and remorse leave her worn-down and consumed by guilt. When the leader of that gang suddenly re-emerges, Erin embarks on an obsessive quest to find his former associates, bring him to justice and make peace with her tortured past.

programme.desc: For many years, Nathan Harper (Taylor Lautner) has had the uneasy feeling that life with his family isn't quite what it seems. His fears come true when he finds a picture of himself as a youngster on a missing-persons website, proof that the people he's called mom and dad his whole life are not his real parents. As he draws close to uncovering his true identity, Nathan becomes the target of assassins, forcing him to flee with his neighbor, Karen (Lily Collins), the only person he can now trust.

programme.title: Acts of Violence
programme.desc: Three Midwestern brothers, a crime lord, and an incorruptible cop are on a deadly collision course when the youngest brother's fiancée is kidnapped by human traffickers. To save her, the MacGregor boys call on their military training -- and the strength of family -- to fight the most important battle of their lives.

programme.title: No Escape
programme.desc: American businessman Jack Dwyer, wife Annie and their two young daughters arrive in Southeast Asia to begin a new life. As his company plans to improve the region's water quality, the family quickly learns that they're right in the middle of a political uprising. Armed rebels attack the hotel where they're staying, ordered to kill any foreigners that they encounter. Amid the chaos, Jack must find a way to save himself and his loved ones from the violence erupting all around them.

programme.title: Traitor
programme.desc: When straight-arrow agent Roy Clayton (Guy Pearce) assumes command of a special FBI task force, he becomes entangled in a web of covert operations. All the clues in Clayton's investigation point to Samir Horn (Don Cheadle), a former Special Ops soldier who now aids terrorists. But as Clayton digs deeper and contradictory evidence begins to emerge, he begins to question Horn's motives.

programme.title: Patriots Day
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes on April 15, 2013, when two bombs explode during the Boston Marathon. In the aftermath of the attack, police Sgt. Tommy Saunders (Mark Wahlberg), FBI Special Agent Richard DesLauriers (Kevin Bacon) and Commissioner Ed Davis (John Goodman) join courageous survivors, first responders and other investigators in a race against the clock to hunt down the suspects and bring them to justice.

programme.title: Stand Up Guys
programme.desc: After serving 28 years in prison for accidentally killing the son of a crime boss, newly paroled gangster Val (Al Pacino) reunites with his former partners in crime, Doc (Christopher Walken) and Hirsch (Alan Arkin), for a night on the town. As the three men revisit old haunts, reflect on their glory days and try to make up for lost time, one wrestles with a terrible quandary: Doc has orders to kill Val, and time is running out for him to figure out a way out of his dilemma.

programme.title: War on Everyone
programme.desc: Two corrupt cops, who make money blackmailing criminals, come up against one who may be far more dangerous than both of them.

programme.title: Pawn Shop Chronicles
programme.desc: An Elvis impersonator, meth-addicted white supremacists, and a man searching for his wife hunt for a missing wedding ring.

programme.title: Next Day Air
programme.desc: Delivery man Leo Jackson (Donald Faison) is definitely on the wrong road to success. He still lives at home, he and his girlfriend just broke up, and he has multiple complaints stacked against him at work. Fortunately, Leo has plenty of marijuana to keep his mind off his troubles. But when he accidentally delivers a box of cocaine to the wrong address, Leo finds himself in the middle of a bad deal that may just cost him his life.

programme.title: American Psycho
programme.desc: In New York City in 1987, a handsome, young urban professional, Patrick Bateman (Christian Bale), lives a second life as a gruesome serial killer by night. programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati experiences the Escaramuza — An all-female horse riding and skills competition. In the kitchen, Pati makes Jalisco-style birria and her friend, pastry chef and cookbook author Fany Gerson, joins her to make gelatinas for dessert.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.sub-title: An Underground Pit of Cochinita Pibil

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.sub-title: A Mayan League of their Own

programme.title: The Dawns Here are Quiet (English Version)
programme.desc: It is late spring of 1942, and World War 2 is in full swing. A long way off from the front-line the Germans make an air landing operation in an attempt to get through to the Kirov railway and the White Sea - Baltic Sea Canal. The only obstacle in their way is an anti-aircraft artillery unit of corporal Vaskov and five young women in training.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Speeding behind German lines the men of Troop A, in their armored cars and half-tracks left destruction and fear in their wake. Surprising the German garrison at the town of Epernay, they established an outpost from which they could defend a counter-attack. Outnumbered and outgunned with thirteen rounds of ammunition left, these brave GI's held this vital town until re-enforcements could arrive.

programme.title: After Hitler
programme.desc: May 1945: At last the Nazi shadow is lifting...War has devastated the continent, and now everyone just wants to get back to living again... But though the guns are now quiet, the Second World War isn't over yet. The Third Reich may have surrendered but the violence just won't seem to end.

programme.title: Great Tank Battles
programme.desc: The third episode opens with Rommel's second offensive in North Africa. The following summer the German offensive at Kharkov and the subsequent push past the River Don towards Volga and Stalingrad, later the scene of Germany's first major defeat - The Battle of Stalingrad. The scene is switched to North Africa following the continuous battle between the British 8th Army, the Desert Rats.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: Russia In Afghanistan
programme.desc: In 1979, the Soviets had ill-suited uniforms and inferior fighting tactics, and found it impossible to defeat the popular Afghan guerrilla army. They had underestimated their enemy and lacked the forces to win.

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: Another basic building block of civilization and warfare is the ship. From the Second Millennia BC, ships were used to transport troops to battle. The Egyptians and Syrians crossed the sea to do battle, and when they weren't fighting each other, they would use their vessels for trade, exploration and probably a little piracy! From the 7th and 6th centuries B.C, formal navies appeared.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: Japan unprovoked invasion had plunged China into war and Europe had been brought to the brink of conflict. In Italy Mussolini introduced fascism to the political landscape and Hitler dismantled democracy. Their expansion threatened neighboring nations.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: From September 20 to October 20, 1950 United Nations forces struck hard against the Communist army in Korea. Footage shows the recapture of Seoul, the fall of the North Korean capital city, Pyongyang, an airdrop by the 187th Regimental Airdrop team, and the U.S. Navy battleship Missouri in action.
programme.sub-title: Big Picture: The United Nations Offensive

programme.title: Architects of Darkness
programme.desc: A journey into his world. The film explores the roots of Adolf Hitler and traces the story of his life from the town of his birth to his final days in a Berlin bunker.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: Describes the pacification and Vietnamization efforts of the U.S. Army in Vietnam.

programme.title: My Grandparents' War
programme.desc: Kristin Scott Thomas's grandfather William served as a Commanding officer in the Royal Navy throughout WW2. He survived some of the most devastating battles from Dunkirk to D-Day but never spoke about his experiences. For the first time, Kristin uncovers how he saved thousands at Dunkirk and endured the horrors of the Russian Artic convoys. Kristin's journey is packed with revelation and emotion.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: Worldwide, the conflict continued to escalate as Japan made their presence felt as signatories of the Tripartite Pact, giving Hitler's Axis of Evil more power. Britain stood alone as the nightly bombing raids of the Blitz devastated major cities.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: The Luftwaffe continued its attempts to bomb Britain into submission, while the German Afrika Korps strengthened its position as Rommel, Hitler's 'Desert Fox', took charge. At sea the naval forces battle each other and the elements.
programme.sub-title: On Land in the Air and All at Sea: January-March 1941

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Prefabricated concrete barges are manufactured in preparation for D Day. U.S. troops storm a beach in a practice landing assault. How harbor facilities made in England were used in the Normandy invasion. A storm damages the harbor but unloading continues.
programme.sub-title: Newsreel Reports on Preparation for D-Day

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Invasion of Southern France by the 7th army and subsequent junction with the American 3rd army in northwest part of France.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: In 1930s Germany, the Nazi Party created the Hitler Youth to indoctrinate children and adolescents with Nazi ideology and prepare them to become a child army for Hitler. This episode traces the rise of the movement, from early everyday life indoctrination, through to the war.
programme.sub-title: The Hitler Youth: Nazi Child Army

programme.title: D-Day: 100 Days for Freedom
programme.desc: June 6, 1944-150,000 Allied soldiers land on Normandy's shores in Operation Overlord, one of history's largest military campaigns. Through rare colorized archives and personal testimonies, this episode relives the chaos, courage, and tragedy of D-Day, as the Allies fight to secure a foothold in occupied France.

programme.title: The Vietnam War: The Invisible Enemy
programme.desc: The second part of the story of the Vietnam War from the perspective of both sides, including rare war time footage from North Vietnamese sources.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: Americans arrive in Britain, try to get along with the British civilians, and are made ready physically and mentally to fight the Germans. The Eighth Air Force begins its bombing offensive, and the decision is made to invade French North Africa.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Sergeant Cleo Lehenbauer, nicknamed 'Indestructible,' is wounded during the 101st Airborne's D-Day jump and after being hospitalized returns to Normandy. In September, he walks through a mine infested field and rescues two comrades in Holland. After conflicts with his commander in the 5th Armored Division, he transfers back to the 101st, where he helps stop the last major German offensive.

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: The Fall of Saigon occurred on April 30, 1975 when the South Vietnamese government announced its unconditional surrender to North Vietnam. As a line of tanks smashed through the gates of the presidential palace, Vietcong troops rounded up government soldiers, and raised their red and blue flags. The United States Embassy remained under control of the U.S. Marines.

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: The 3rd Battalion, Ninth Marines wading ashore 10 miles west of Da Nang in March 1965 marked the beginning of the Corps commitment to the war in Vietnam. This is the story of why they were called in and their first actions against the Viet Cong. The Battalions initial orders read in part ...to conduct security missions, reconnaissance operations, and offensive operations as directed.

programme.title: Nazi Death Marches: 1944-1945
programme.desc: Through exclusive film archives and written journals, we will reveal a lesser known chapter of the end of the Third Reich, a story of brutality and murder. In the final months of World War II, 700,000 prisoners were evacuated from concentration camps and traveled throughout Europe. 250,000 to 300,000 died from exhaustion or were massacred by the guards or even civilians in Austria and Germany.

programme.title: Auschwitz - Voices of 44 Survivors
programme.desc: End of the 1930s, in Occupied Europe. From one day to the next, young men, women and their families found themselves excluded, persecuted, hunted down and arrested, simply for being Jewish. They would soon be deported far from home, to a place that became the ultimate symbol of horror: Auschwitz, Nazi Germany's largest concentration and extermination camp.

programme.title: Night Swallows
programme.desc: Evgeniya 'Zhenya' Zvonareva, lead pilot of the female aviation regiment, receives the Order of Kutuzov for destroying Sturmbannführer Neumann's camp. However, the victory owed to friend Galya Shevchenko, once the top night bomber, now demoted to mechanic after tribunal. Zhenya must destroy an enemy ammo-and-fuel depot; a sabotage team led by Captain Aleksandr Makeev will join.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: Hitler, Göring, and Himmler shared a strange obsession with animals, using them as propaganda tools, symbols of ideology, and even weapons of war. Far beyond affection, their fascination fueled pseudo-scientific projects and genetic manipulation. Through archives, expert insight, and re-enactments, this documentary uncovers how the Nazis exploited nature to serve their brutal vision.

programme.title: Jets
programme.desc: The air war in Vietnam was unlike any other. It was the full might of the world's greatest military power pitted against an elusive, but highly motivated enemy. From an air combat perspective, the Vietnam War provided the superpowers, the US and the USSR, with the opportunity to put their best technology, and weapons systems, into the sky to fight it out.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Gen. Eisenhower addresses troops in Southern England; the 'Big Show' begins; airborne troops dropped behind enemy lines; support aircraft drop everything from howitzers to motorcycles; bombers blast bridges and supply lines; sea forces bombard enemy fortifications on French coast; British and second army swarm over coast at Omaha and Utah Beaches; German west wall broken.
programme.sub-title: D-Day - The Battle in the Air

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: On 30 January 1933, Hitler became chancellor and the Nazis quickly seized state power. Foreign diplomats in Berlin, turned into spies and whistleblowers, witnessed both Nazi infiltration of high society and the exclusion of Jews. Drawing on rare archives, this documentary reveals their warnings about the rise of National Socialism-and how the world ignored them.
programme.sub-title: Ambassadors in Berlin: The Whistleblowers of WWII

programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: 1943 marks the turning point in the war, as the Allies open new fronts. The invasion of Italy, the battle for Stalingrad, and the island-hopping campaigns in the Pacific begin to turn the tide. This episode shows how ordinary soldiers endured unimaginable hardships, and how the Axis powers started to suffer significant losses, signaling the beginning of their decline.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: Ewald von Kleist has broken through to the Terek river, slap in front of the vital oil fields of Grozny and Baku. Only freezing temperatures in the Caucasus prevent von Kleist's 1st Panzer Army from breaking through to Ozoni Kizi and Tbilisi. The Soviets launch a desperate counter-attack that holds the Germans back.

programme.title: WWI The War To End All Wars - Part 1: The Valley of Death
programme.desc: June 1914, Europe was in the midst of an idealic summer. The nations of Europe were joined together by webs of trade and capital. Their royal houses linked by bonds of family and marriage. Global trade was at an all time high. The prospect of all an all out European war was unthinkable, pundits said. No one saw the catastrophe coming, until it came. World War I - The War to End All Wars.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: Wars in the Middle East Collection
programme.desc: Iraq's 1990 invasion of Kuwait resulted in more than one million troops facing off against each other in the desert of the Persian Gulf. The Allied Coalition's air war, known as Operation Desert Storm, involved the most sophisticated technological weaponry available.
programme.sub-title: Modern Warfare: The Persian Gulf War - Part 2

programme.title: Late War Fighters of the Luftwaffe
programme.desc: Hitler was losing the war in 1944. In the East, Russians rolled forward relentlessly, threatening the existence of Hitler's Third Reich. Hitler knew that if he were to survive, he needed a miracle. New technologies, or miracle weapons, could turn the tide of war. Against all odds, German engineers not only designed but produced in good numbers some of the best aircraft of the war, the ME262.

programme.title: The Death Train
programme.desc: this film revisits the first massive crime of WWII killing 13,000 people in the city of Lasi, Romania that lays out the early stages of the Shoah. This is possible thanks to unique archives - including unpublished photographs - and interviews of the last survivors.

programme.title: WWII: Mysteries in the Archives 1938-1948
programme.desc: On June 6, 1944, the Normandy Landings, officially called Operation Overlord, began. This massive battle was also the largest media operation ever, with hundreds of reporters capturing footage under heavy fire. Among the first waves on beaches like Juno, Omaha, and Utah, these brave photographers shaped our collective visual memory of World War II.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Two of our favorite things come together in this episode - pasta and one pan meals. First, Slow Cooking expert Michele Scicolone shows us how to make a delicious Pork Ragu with Broken Lasagna in the slow cooker. Then Sara makes a Pearl Couscous with Shellfish, and explains what pans are essential to stock a kitchen.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Pasta in a Pan

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: It's a stuffed pasta showdown as Sara travels to an ancient Tuscan villa to learn the secrets of homemade ravioli from a real Italian chef, a delicious but time-consuming task involving asparagus, goat cheese and a whole lot of chianti. Back home in her American kitchen, Sara shows us a hack to make a homemade ravioli stuffed with spicy greens, quick enough for a weeknight and pretty darn tasty. Which is best? Only the cook knows.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - BASTA PASTA: US VS ITALY

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Chef Stellino reconnects with his Italian roots as he guides the viewer through some simple and exciting techniques on how to make traditional Italian pasta dishes with the elegance and panache of an Italian born chef, with a plateful of tips, techniques and ideas to help anyone improve their style and performance in the kitchen.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - It Is all about Pasta!

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: The most popular of all pasta sauces finally makes its appearance and chef Stellino is absolutely giddy as he joyfully shares with his viewers his favorite pasta dish from his youth. Simple, easy to follow techniques are at the heart of every success, and to celebrate our good fortune let's all make a fluffy zabaglione.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Pasta with Bolognese Ragu and Strawberries with Zabaglione

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Stellino makes and plates his favorite pasta dishes.
programme.sub-title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - The Love of Pasta

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Radicchio and Gorgonzola Pasta
programme.desc: Tangy gorgonzola cheese with crisp, red radicchio in creamy sauce with meltingly tender, stewed sweet red.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing like pasta to bring Lidia's family to the table. In this episode, Lidia shares some of her favorite pasta dishes including a comforting Baked Rigatoni with Zucchini, a delicious Penne with Ricotta and Mushrooms and one of her personal favorites, Fettuccine with a Clam and Leek Sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Everybody loves pasta! In this episode, Lidia starts with the simplest - a Spaghettini with Olive oil and Rosemary, then moves on to a hearty dish of Tagliatelle with Meatballs and Eggplant, and finishes with a delicious whole wheat pasta- Baked Whole Wheat Penne with Ceci Beans.
programme.sub-title: Lidia's Kitchen - Trio of Heartwarming Pasta

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia whips up Mafalde Florentine Style and savory Loin Lamb Chops. For dessert, Grandma Rosa's Apple Cake.

With her powers constantly evolving, Morton must now stop the resurrected monster as she embarks on a furious rampage through the streets of London.

The story is set up to create a taut cat-and-mouse game between Griffin and FBI agent Joel Campbell.

Refusing to become hapless victims, Riley and her friends decide to band together and fight back against the psychotic Christmas killer.

Once there, he discovers the legend of Mary Shaw (Joan Heney), a murdered ventriloquist whose eerie presence still looms over the town. As he desperately digs for answers, Jamie encounters the curse that took his wife's life and threatens his own.

programme.desc: Asking whether genes determine one's essential nature and identity, or one builds their own identity; exploring the essentialist and constructed philosophies; how one might incorporate aspects of both into their own view of personal identity.

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA

programme.sub-title: What Genetic Testing Brings to Ancestry

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: There are many social issues affecting an individual's emotional response to receiving DNA ancestry results; how the reciprocal engagement method can help families face unexpected ancestry results; tips to consider before ordering one's own test.

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: People want a family narrative, whereas DNA just "wants" to move itself forward and is neutral on issues of race, subterfuge or social connection; how to create a strategic family narrative to incorporate the scientific facts of DNA ancestry results.
programme.sub-title: When Family Narrative Meets Genetic Testing

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: From the case of Henrietta Lacks to that of the Hagahai people of Papua New Guinea, scientists and government agencies have a history of bad actions with respect to biological samples; learn about the laws and programs in place to protect privacy.
programme.sub-title: Privacy Versus Connection in DNA Testing

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: Learning about the DNA Discussion Project and its goals; current results regarding the ways in which DNA ancestry tests are changing identity; looking at questions about unanticipated results, sharing DNA ancestry results and social implications.

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: A genogram is a graphic tool used to explore family history and relationships over a two- to three-generation period, discovering the powerful information that can be conveyed through a genogram as opposed to the traditional family tree diagram.

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: Exploring the issue of birth assisted by reproductive technologies by meeting Maria, who learns as a teenager that she was born with the help of intrauterine insemination; considering how this knowledge affects an adolescent's identity.

programme.desc: Llenas de incredulidad, las especulaciones brotan por todos lados y a Ismael le toca la peor parte, recibe una visita que lo conmueve y lo enfurece. La orden de un juez llega al hospital.

programme.desc: Las sospechas señalan a Corina Saldaña como la infiltrada, su puesto en la DEA pende de un hilo. Aurelio Casillas se acerca a ella para saber si es cómplice de la estrategia de enterrarlo vivo.

programme.desc: El destino los une otra vez, "La Felina" no puede creer lo que ve con sus propios ojos y sin perder un segundo coloca dos toneladas de droga, una conexión directa entre México y Venezuela.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: A solas, Mecha y Casillas se preguntan quién es quién, él se entera de qué perfil de hombre desea ella. Con un bisturí él se corta el área donde tiene el chip insertado, Mecha se lo extrae.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La mayor motivación de Aurelio es reunirse con su familia y hace todo lo posible para lograrlo. Tracy Lobo debe demostrar que puede detener a Casillas, su ascenso está en juego.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Una persecución sin frenos desata una balacera entre la DEA y Aurelio Casillas. En el camino, Mecha lo ayuda sin saber quién es él, las descargas lo aturden. Aguirre reporta una baja.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mecha esconde a Aurelio en un túnel y el coqueteo surge de la nada. Lucas Manzano le da un ultimátum a Tracy Lobo: si no atrapa a Casillas a la medianoche, debe finalizar el operativo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El olfato de Tracy Lobo apunta a la fábrica de hielo donde está el escondite de Casillas, mientras él está abrumado por los recuerdos. Detienen al "Pollo" y da un falso testimonio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Cuando los Casillas van a darle el último adiós a Doña Alba y "El Pulque", les tienden una trampa, atrás quedan las balas, el fentanilo es protagonista.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio confirma la muerte de su madre y se entera de que Luzma está grave. "Uña de tigre" le cuenta sobre el intento de asesinato múltiple en el funeral de Doña Alba, "Pío" lideró el ataque.
